The following naming convention is followed while giving the document reference number. <PRODUCT_ID>-<FG>-<DOC_NAME>-<VERSION>. Where, PRODUCT_ID : Denotes the product ID. For example – DP-SPL-5656 FG : Denotes the finished good number. Where, For document common for all FGs - 000 For document configurable for individual FGs – 300, 600 etc. DOC_NAME : Denotes the short form or acronym of document name. For example : “HRS” for Hardware Requirements Specification VERSION : Denotes version of the document. For example “1V00” For example, document reference number : Common FG - DP-SPL-5656-000-HRS-1V00 Individual FG - DP-SPL-5656-300-HRS-1V00
